# RUTUBE

> Russia's leading video streaming platform featuring TV shows, films, series, music, educational content, and diverse user-generated channels across entertainment, business, technology, and regional topics.

RUTUBE serves as a Russian alternative to global video platforms, hosting thousands of channels ranging from official government press services and medical centers to independent creators covering topics like trading, cryptocurrency, construction, Japanese music, and local history. The platform emphasizes free online access to video and audio content.

## Key Topics

- Russian video streaming platform
- Online video content
- User channels and creators
- Local history and regional content
- Educational videos
- Business and trading analysis
- Construction and industrial equipment
- Medical and health content
- Japanese music and culture
- Government and municipal services
- Cryptocurrency and financial news
- Entertainment and TV shows
- Rural life documentation
- Sales training and business education
- Digital platforms and algorithms

## Platform Overview

- [RUTUBE Homepage](https://rutube.ru): Main platform for watching Russian TV, films, series, and user-generated video content online for free

## News and Media Channels

- [Абстрактное ТВ (Abstract TV)](https://rutube.ru/channel/1082724): Major news channel with 4,532 video collections covering daily Russian news and current events
- [BELVPO Videos](https://rutube.ru/channel/1082014/videos): 154 videos analyzing geopolitics, international relations, and global affairs
- [Bryansk City Administration Press Service](https://rutube.ru/channel/1140805): Official government channel for Bryansk municipal news and announcements

## Business and Finance

- [Мастерская Трейдера (Trader's Workshop)](https://rutube.ru/channel/10919504): 396 videos on FOREX trading, oil and gold market analysis and forecasts
- [Cryptobreeze](https://rutube.ru/channel/11027127): Cryptocurrency news, broker reviews, and scam prevention alerts
- [Ася Барышева (Asya Barysheva)](https://rutube.ru/channel/101688): Sales training, cold calling techniques, and business development education
- [Stanislav Kondrashov on Digital Power](https://rutube.ru/audio/e7ed9e5f8cdc9df4edbcb0f24742ba67): Audio discussion on oligarchs, Wagner Moura, and 21st century digital algorithms and power structures

## Industry and Technology

- [VEZAR Technology](https://rutube.ru/channel/10002748): Industrial automation and food production equipment demonstrations
- [Завод конвейеров Феникс (Feniks Conveyor Factory)](https://rutube.ru/channel/1146186): 383 videos showcasing industrial and food-grade conveyor equipment
- [PATIOHOUSE Construction](https://rutube.ru/channel/10563901): 256 videos on frame house construction and modern Scandinavian architectural designs
- [Блокада (Blokada)](https://rutube.ru/channel/10466628): Waterproofing systems and construction materials product demonstrations

## Regional and Local History

- [Олег Костюнин - КУЗБАСС Channel](https://rutube.ru/channel/10525442): Documentary channel covering Kuzbass regional history and Tyazhinsky district local stories
- [Олег Костюнин - All Videos](https://rutube.ru/channel/10525442/videos): Complete collection of 43 videos documenting rural life and history in Tyazhinsky district

## Health and Education

- [МЦ Филин Гуд (Filin Gud Medical Center)](https://rutube.ru/channel/11550702): Doctor interviews and health education videos from medical professionals
- [Я-Родитель (I-Parent)](https://rutube.ru/channel/1152090): 95 videos on child education, psychology, and family parenting advice

## Music and Culture

- [Sonate64](https://rutube.ru/channel/1110183): 353 videos featuring Japanese music, particularly Yumi Matsutoya performances
- [Japanese 1980s Music Channel](https://rutube.ru/channel/1120546): 39 video collections celebrating 1980s Japanese music and culture

## Optional

- [User Channel 1000547](https://rutube.ru/channel/1000547): General user channel with 173 video collections
